post.caption: Drake's tooth diamond looked like a pepper. Drake wore a pink diamond set in a front tooth. In 2018 an Instagram user said his teeth did not look clean, and Drake replied that it was a pink diamond. At London's Wireless Festival, comedian Mo Gilligan met him. A friend said he had a little red thing in his tooth. Drake asked if it was gone, then asked if it was a pepper, then realized it was his own diamond. Gilligan told the story on The Tonight Show in 2024. Drake commented that he changed the diamond after that, because it was the tenth time someone called it food.
